horoscopes.horoscope: The stars today may play some tricks, which may land you in some sort of problem. But by mid-day, things will calm down and you will forget it. Ganesha says that in the evening, you will be calm and pensive which is an excellent thing. Since Ganesha knows you’d be rather touchy in love today, the wise Lord advises you to keep a tight rein on your emotions. Avoid emotional outburst at any cost, warns Ganesha. You might not be feeling excited with your partner. The day is going to start with lot of communication which may make you feel bit tired and worked up. You will need to keep your mobiles and laptops aside for a while in order to have a moment of respite. So many things will keep you busy that you will not have much time to spare for financial matters. You would like to boost your finances, but today you will give time to your family members. You will be under pressure to perform your best. Avoid any delays, says Ganesha. You will start your day by attending phone calls and answering emails. However, planets are not really in your favour today, so watch out for any conflict situations, warns Ganesha.

You will want to be in control today and this could lead to verbal skirmish and resentment, says Ganesha. Some task might baffle you enough to drive you to your wit’s end this afternoon. It would be best to sit together and thrash out individual differences in the larger interest of the family, suggests Ganesha. Relief! Your emotional stability is at its peak. You will feel sensual with your partner. Getting closer with your loved one would be easier than ever. Get ready for sudden showers of hugs and kisses from your sweetheart. A wonderful night is on the cards, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today you will be able to focus on your food habits, which will keep you in good health. Though you may be somewhat confused about what to eat and what to avoid, you will end up selecting food which is good for you. You will hanker after money in the early part of the day, says Ganesha. Financial matters will definitely occupy your mind space. You will strive to maintain things as they are. Instead of seeing the silver lining, you will notice the dark clouds of doubt that will fog your thoughts. As evening approaches, a bright ray of sunshine will dispel the gloom. A piece of good news from faraway land may put you on in good cheer, foresees Ganesha.

The first half of the day should see you fresh and rosy with enthusiasm. You will be able to channel your energies in the right direction today. You will be able to pursue projects which really interest you. You will likely spend your lunch time in the company of friends and family. Overall, a productive and satisfying day awaits, says Ganesha. Cosmic undercurrents reveal that your mind remains peaceful for being with your loved one. This good mood should convert into some emotional tête-à-tête between you and your sweetheart. A funny discussion or a rom-com movie might help you get relaxed, feels Ganesha. You day will begin with lot of energy. You will be very happy with everything that’s happening in your life. Ganesha feels that you should plan your day with activities that are important to you because a satisfactory day ahead awaits you. You may consider various aspects related to life and money both today in the early stages of the day. You will do your best to balance your income and expenses. A wonderful day for you foresees Ganesha. Because you will sincerely perform your tasks in the office, you will feel pretty satisfied with your day’s work. Technical decision making will fetch smooth results. There will not be any issues on the cards, foresees Ganesha.

You will savour a tasty meal. You will go out for dinner with your friends or family. It may so happen that you will take out time from your hectic schedule to prepare tasty food and invite friends and relatives. Your nature of helping others will make you popular and you will benefit from it, says Ganesha. Your sweet talks will bring your sweetheart closer to you. Your loved one will fulfill all your emotional needs and you will end the day on a pleasurable note. A cheerful selfie of both of you will create a positive aura in the current relationship, feels Ganesha. When the day begins, you may feel tired and may not wish to go work. You may just want to relax and chat with friends personally or online. However, if you go to work, you may take the day forward positively. Ganesha feels you shall be lavish today. You don’t usually calculate and tend to follow your heart when it comes to financial matters. Today also you shall follow the same pattern in money matters. Avoid taking up tasks that demand you to rack your brains. However, as the day proceeds, positive planetary energies will enable you to hold important meetings. Be careful while making decisions. A wrong turn might jeopardise all your plans, warns Ganesha.

Do not underscore your influence and importance today, says Ganesha. You hold the key to many doors, and hence, your ability to influence people is at its strongest today. In business, this means that you have a major role to play in new deals. But remember that you merely hold the keys, you cannot predict what lies behind each door. So do not let disappointment cloud your mind if outcomes fall below your expectations. In any case, your disappointment shall not last because come evening, the stars take you on a wonderful candlelit dinner with your sweetheart. You might feel sensitive to your partner’s reaction. Try to see the positive side of your loved one. If you are truly dedicated to your partner, a small brawl will not affect your relationship. Preparing a walnut cupcake for your spouse will sweeten the bond, feels Ganesha. The day is going to start well as you will be in good health and mood. In the first half of the day, you will be clear in thinking and actions. However, in the second half of the day your energy level may drop. You will have a good grip over money matters in the first half of the day. In the second half, you shall blow up your money on unnecessary things, or in futile pursuits. Everything thing will go suspiciously smooth as you begin your day, but that’s just the lull before the storm. The day might take a chaotic turn post noon and you might face unexpected twists related to work or decision making, feels Ganesha.

Watch you step, warns Ganesha. Trouble is lurking just round the corner and waiting to waylay you. At work, you will find yourself in a high-spirited mood and will be helpful to your colleagues. You might end the day in the company of family members recollecting the happy days you have spent in each other’s company. You will have philosophical discussions with your lover on the meaning of love. This should help both of you understand each other better. However, avoid being too much analytical as it may lose interest in your loved one. After all, you need to know how to stimulate your sweetheart. You will get up in the morning feeling very happy and peppy. Ganesha therefore advises you to take up challenging tasks, because success is bound to come your way today. Also spare some time for your loved ones in evening. Stars are indicating gains through past efforts and investments both. The day is highly favourable for negotiations. If you are working on commission bases, this can be one of the best days for getting good commission. It’s only at the post lunch that you may feel full of energy and embark on routine tasks. However, that’s not because of the meal you’ve had, it’s because of your planets’ position. Challenges are on the cards. It’s better if you avoid taking up too many challenges, suggests Ganesha.

An extended family is a boon, especially when it comes to charting out some success. Okay, maybe it’s not Don Corleone calling the shots in your favour; but expect to get a favourable base from your relatives for the same. Bring your luck with you to work, and keep smiling. Yes, it is your dazzling smile that will help you win people’s hearts, says Ganesha. Be receptive to your partner’s emotions if you want to attain the desired compatibility. Listen, feel, and support your loved one. Ganesha feels that you will be able to drag your partner’s attention and eventually have loving and long lasting relationship. The day will require lot of energy from you and you will have a lot of energy to deal with it. Besides, during the entire day, you are going to be spreading positive vibes, feels Ganesha. People will love to connect with you. Ganesha says that financial matters will be important today. You will think of yourself as lucky in money matters and will not keep brooding about your financial situation. “With your stars shining bright, luck will walk by your side,” sings Ganesha. With your hard work, you will unlock doors of opportunity. You will express your passion for the work you love. You will grab the best thing out of opportunities after a thorough logical consideration.

Today, you may be at your creative best and encourage various forms of arts. If the passion grows, you may even consider taking lessons in classical music or dance. Love is in the air during the evening. Ganesha foresees a romantic dinner and drive with your beloved. Tonight you might plan a candlelit dinner at your verandah. Soft music, delicious cuisine, great wine and the lovely smile on your partner’s face will make the night truly exotic. A beautiful night is on the cards, so cherish it as much as you can. In the first half of the day, you will have to take very good care of your health. You must not overload your mind today, as you will feel tired very easily. During the second half of the day, your energy level will get boosted. You shall be worried about money matters today, feels Ganesha. These worries will be regarding long-term monetary matters, inheritance or joint finances with your partners. Today, you are determined to give 100% to your work, so much so that your boss will struggle to find errors in your tasks. Ganesha advises you to consider pending projects and wrap up important ones first. Finding a solution for your problems will be easier if you properly monitor.

Self-righteousness, and a sense of duty set the mood for the day today. You’ll be a miserly scrooge in the afternoon. But later in the day, expect dinner with your sweetheart to be extravagant and blissful. You will spend an intimate time with your partner, nuzzling, and cuddle without a care in the world. Loving, caring and being truthful with your partner makes you the most demanded lover on the earth, feels Ganesha. You will create a soothing magic in the heart of your loved one. The day will be average from health point of view. It will be very difficult for you to remain in stable mood. While health may not be a big problem in the first half of the day, you could face many psychological problems. Later in the day, Ganesha foresees that you will be balanced about your financial situation. Income or expenses will both receive equal consideration on your part. Beware! A peeved colleague is out to get you today. However, since his or her stars aren’t strong enough, you’ll be spared any damage to prestige or property. Your productivity will wane as the day proceeds. Just see that the boss doesn’t find you twiddling your thumb.

You mark dates on calendar to sneak away for a small vacation near by, but because of the heavy workload, you always have to cancel the plans. You don’t need to plan, in fact, you can take an impromptu vacation, feels Ganesha. Take one now! Get a roadmap and drive away from the hassle of the city. Don’t get caught in petty emotional issues. The day will be much better on the personal front. Your partner might ask you some important matters related to the heart. However, avoid being too rigid and practical. Just open up to make him/her feel how special you are. The day is going to begin on a slightly sluggish note, feels Ganesha. You may suffer from cold or cough. The day can be demanding at both personal and professional fronts so there may be certain amount of emotional stress that you will be experiencing. In the first half of the day today you will focus hard on financial matters related to your routine life. You will try to figure out where the money is going and will try curtail wasteful expenses. You will turn a bit demanding today as you are expecting the desired results. Your emotional and practical side will be locked in pitched battle today. You’ll be able to work only in the first half of the day, says Ganesha.

Who doesn’t like to have a heavier pocket? You will be pleased to have little extra cash in your wallet. Also, you will pay attention to your financial planning and position, says Ganesha. Beware! The green-eyed people around you will try to distract you from your path, so keep your guards on, advises Ganesha. You may just walk around with your lover in the evening and if you feel tired, then fall asleep in the lap of your sweetheart and dive into a wonderful dream. You will be blessed with your better half, feels Ganesha. You will be performance oriented and performance focussed during the first half of the day where as second half of the day will draw your attention towards health, feels Ganesha. You should not waste time behind fruitless aims and must decide your priorities. Today is a good time to book your profits, feels Ganesha, as if you wait any longer, you may receive the same amount of profits. You will be worried about your children’s expenses. The entire day you will be busy in technical troubleshooting. From ASCII to XML, all technical things will occupy your time in the office today. Obviously, this will leave you mentally drained. Learning the easiest method and applying the things logically might lessen your workload.

You need to be extremely careful when planning out your activities for the day, says Ganesha. For the slightest mistake could bring all your efforts to naught. Treading carefully and cautiously is advisable, when it comes to work-related matters, to avoid falling into traps. You will be more dependent on luck today. In times of great difficulty, you will find that god lends a helping hand. You may turn selfish and may not show any interest in love life. Romance might sound a far-off thing, you will feel indifferent to emotional appeals, says Ganesha. Logical arguments on emotional matters may be too risky and may hard-hit your love life. You will be in good health during the first half of the day. However, you may get confused about things today which will stress your mind a bit. Arguments may make you feel tired or may make you feel stressed, so stay calm with others. You will be experiencing wild moods today, predicts Ganesha. You shall be more emotional, confused and worked up than usual. You need to spend your spare money on creative pursuits. The day sees you at sixes and sevens on numerous issues. Today’s planetary alignment will not allow you to stick to one thing and your mind will waver. As a result, you may be in the confused state of mind and cannot focus. Eventually, you’ll end up postponing your tasks.
